situation.estimate: A NYC AI SRE company founded by causal-ML academics (Columbia/Cornell/MIT). It raised a $120M Series B at a $1B valuation on 3 Nov 2026 (Kleiner, Redpoint, Khosla co-led; Sequoia, Battery). It sells to Fortune 100/500 enterprises (Amex, PepsiCo, DigitalOcean, Nubank). It went from founder-led to a built GTM org in 2026: an SVP Sales, an SVP Marketing and RVPs in March, the team 'more than doubled' in two months, and LinkedIn shows about 114 employees. Marketing is now scaling brand, content, PMM and field, and has run an aggressive SEO/AEO content engine since about July 2026. Next: broadening from incident RCA to 'self-driving production' (Workers, MCP, self-healing), in a crowded category where incumbents (Datadog Bits AI SRE, PagerDuty, incident.io, Splunk, Elastic) and about 20 startups all fight for the same 'AI SRE' terms.

site_and_content.craft_verdict: High craft: an answer-first AEO format, a glossary cluster, listicles that rank Traversal #1, vs pages and AI-crawler policy. This is an owned, active program, not a gap. The gaps are narrower: the 'Traversal alternatives' and competitor-authored 'X vs Traversal' results, and vs coverage of challengers.

seo_need.cost_of_absence: Right after a $1B-valuation round, the most commercial queries about Traversal itself ('Traversal alternatives', 'X vs Traversal', 'Traversal vs Resolve AI') are answered by competitors' pages. AI assistants that cite these will describe Traversal on competitors' terms during enterprise evaluations. Category head terms ('AI SRE platform', 'AI root cause analysis tool') go to Resolve.ai, incident.io and incumbents.
seo_need.why_not_yet: Not a 'never invested' case. Traversal invests heavily (since about Jul 2026, run by the growth team, partly AI-produced via a GTM-engineer-built content agent). The gap is coverage of branded-comparison and alternatives queries, and measuring AI-answer presence, not effort. Best hypothesis: never_prioritized for branded/defensive queries, while the in-house program focuses on category listicles.
